$comment: Design-QA route map. The /design-qa workflow intersects this with the branch diff to decide which rendered routes to visually check. Astro is file-based, so a changed page under src/pages/ maps to its own route automatically; this map exists for SHARED code (layouts, chrome, components) that has no single route of its own — it names a representative sample of routes that exercise that code. Extend it when the workflow reports an uncovered file. Widths mirror the design breakpoints; the 640px nav breakpoint is why 390 is mandatory.

src/layouts/Base.astro.why: global shell + back button; affects every page

checks: nav must not overflow at 390px (measure wordmark + .links scrollWidth + 2*--sp-5 <= viewport)

src/components/Footer.astro.why: global footer link groups + compact disclaimer
